## Hermes digest – ai-news
08:02 Europe/Athens → Talk room of profile ai-news.

Top r/LocalLLaMA posts of the last 24 h from the Reddit Atom feed (descriptive User-Agent). One LLM call without tools (qwen-3.6-35b-a3b) writes a "why it matters" line per post; if it fails, the post's first sentence is used. Nothing new = no message.

Manual run = dry run: the result is returned, nothing is posted. Another workflow can call this one with {"dry_run": false|true, "use_llm": false, "date": "YYYY-MM-DD"}. The workflow is its own error workflow: a failed scheduled run posts one line to the room. Credentials are created by n8n/scripts/hermes-digests-setup.sh.
